obras-civiles.title: Civil works
obras-civiles.summary: Building and extending homes, shops and buildings, with an engineer planning and supervising from day one.
obras-civiles.text: We take your project from start to finish: assessing the land or the existing building, planning, building and handover. We coordinate every trade (structure, masonry, plumbing and electrical) so you have a single person responsible and a project built to technical standards.
includes: New homes and extensions (new floors, rooms, shops)
Earthworks, foundations and site preparation
Full remodels
Technical supervision and crew coordination

plomeria.title: Plumbing
plomeria.summary: Installing and repairing drinking water and wastewater pipes, with lasting solutions for your home or business.
plomeria.text: From a single leak to plumbing a whole house, we use the right materials and pressure tests so the system works without leaks. We also diagnose pressure, damp and drainage problems before they turn into bigger damage.
includes: New drinking water and wastewater installations
Finding and fixing leaks
Pumps, pressure tanks and connections to water tanks
Bathrooms and kitchens: fixtures, taps and drains

plomeria.alt: Pump room with a filter, valves and water pipes
plomeria.metaDescription: Installing and repairing pipes, leaks, pumps and pressure tanks.

electricidad.title: Electrical
electricidad.summary: Safe, tidy home and business electrical installations, built to grow.
electricidad.text: A well-done electrical installation protects your investment and your family. We design and build new installations, update old ones and fix faults, with a properly sized panel and labelled circuits. We also prepare your installation for a generator or a backup system.
includes: New electrical installations and rewiring
Panels, breakers and dedicated circuits
Outlets, lighting and air conditioning points
Preparation for a generator or backup system

electricidad.metaDescription: Safe electrical installations: panels, circuits, lighting and generator preparation.

albanileria.title: Masonry
albanileria.summary: Walls, rendering, floors and finishes done with skill and level, so your space is solid and well finished.
albanileria.text: Masonry is the base of any renovation. We build block walls, render, lay ceramic and porcelain tiles, and repair cracks and damp by finding their cause, not just covering them. We look after levels, right angles and a clean site.
includes: Clay or concrete block walls
Rendering, skimming and preparation for paint
Ceramic and porcelain floors and wall tiles
Crack repair and damp treatment
albanileria.alt: Mason building a block wall with mortar
albanileria.metaDescription: Block walls, rendering, ceramic and porcelain tiles, and crack and damp repair.

drywall.title: Drywall
drywall.summary: Drywall partitions, ceilings and furniture: quick to install, clean and professionally finished.
drywall.text: Drywall lets you rearrange a space without heavy building work: new rooms, offices, ceilings or built-in furniture, with less rubble and in less time. We use galvanised framing and moisture-resistant boards in wet areas, with well-finished joints for a smooth surface.
includes: Partition walls
Ceilings and decorative ceilings with lighting
Built-in furniture and niches
Moisture-resistant boards for bathrooms and kitchens

drywall.metaDescription: Drywall partitions, ceilings and furniture with a professional finish.

concreto-armado.title: Reinforced concrete structures
concreto-armado.summary: Designing, building and strengthening reinforced concrete structures, with a structural engineer's experience.
concreto-armado.text: The structure is what you don't see, but it holds everything up. As a structural engineer, I design and build foundations, columns, beams and slabs, and assess existing structures that show cracks or are going to be extended. Every pour is done with well-placed rebar, proper formwork and correct curing.
includes: Structural calculation and design
Foundations, columns, beams and slabs (including flat roofs)
Crack assessment and strengthening of existing structures
Vertical extensions: new floors on existing buildings

concreto-armado.alt: Rebar laid out for a concrete slab before the pour
concreto-armado.metaDescription: Designing, building and strengthening foundations, columns, beams and slabs.

muros-y-tanques.title: Walls and water tanks
muros-y-tanques.summary: Well-waterproofed reinforced concrete water tanks and walls, to store water safely and hold back the ground.
muros-y-tanques.text: A good tank gives you peace of mind when the water supply fails. We build underground and elevated reinforced concrete tanks, repair leaks and waterproof them inside. We also build retaining and boundary walls designed for the ground loads, with proper drainage.
includes: Underground and elevated reinforced concrete tanks
Waterproofing and leak repair in existing tanks
Retaining walls with structural calculation and drainage
Boundary and enclosure walls

mantenimiento-integral.title: Facility maintenance
mantenimiento-integral.summary: Our own crews for scheduled and corrective maintenance of offices, shops and buildings, with quick response and an engineer's supervision.
mantenimiento-integral.text: We look after your premises as an outsourced maintenance company: regular checks of lighting, plumbing, paint and building systems, and immediate help when something fails. Our team includes plumbers, electricians, masons, air-conditioning technicians, carpenters, metalworkers, locksmiths and drywall installers, coordinated by supervisors. We have done this for corporate offices such as DirecTV's and Digitel's.
includes: Scheduled maintenance: weekly checks of lighting, plumbing, paint and building systems
Corrective maintenance: light fittings, drains, flush valves, locks, glass and electrical points
Painting, waterproofing and drywall work
Office remodelling and additional works, quoted in advance

about.title: I'm involved in every project
about.bio: I'm Miguel Lares, a civil engineer who graduated from UCV in 1979, registered with the CIV under no. 26488, with more than {{engineerYears}} years of experience in civil works, structural reinforcement and maintenance. I lead Proyectos Miluz 10, C.A., a team of engineers, architects and technicians that has worked on buildings, clinics, corporate offices and homes in Caracas, eastern Venezuela and the Andes.
about.presence: From the first assessment to the handover, I'm there so your project is done right.
